raw/items/7/suggestions/V: 为至少一类情境定义输入条件、界面响应和时间约束，例如检测到高工作负荷时在2秒内隐藏非关键信息，并给出可量化阈值。
raw/items/7/issues/0/evidence: The adaptive interface shall adapt to t he situation and the pilot's state and task.
raw/items/7/issues/0/rewrite: The adaptive interface shall change its layout and information presentation based on predefined flight situations, pilot state indicators, and pilot tasks as specified in the adaptation rule set ARS‑R32.
raw/items/8/rationales/U: 大致可理解：为使 UI‑Editor 完整，需集成仿真模块，以便在开发机上离线试用完整系统，再将代码加载到 Vector 系统。
raw/items/8/rationales/A: “complete system off-line”“To make our UI-Editor complete”是主观表述，未说明仿真范围（仅 UI 还是包括 I/O、逻辑），也未定义“incorporated”的集成方式，存在一定歧义。
raw/items/8/rationales/C: 该条是对工具能力的高层要求，与其他条款不明显冲突，但由于“complete system”范围不清，可能与后续对仿真覆盖度或精度的要求冲突。
raw/items/8/rationales/V: 所有评审指出当前不可验证：未定义仿真模块的输入、输出、覆盖范围或成功标准，“try the complete system off-line”无法转化为可测试条件。
raw/items/8/suggestions/U: 去掉“make our UI‑Editor complete”等主观动机性表述，直接描述仿真模块应支持的操作和场景。
raw/items/8/suggestions/A: 明确“simulation module incorporated”指集成在 UI‑Editor 中的一个运行模式，并说明仿真范围（UI 行为、信号交互等）。
raw/items/8/suggestions/C: 将“是否具备仿真模块”与“仿真覆盖哪些功能、达到什么精度”拆分为多条需求，减少混合。
raw/items/8/suggestions/V: 定义仿真模式下的可观察行为（加载生成代码、运行、执行所有界面导航和交互、生成日志等）以及通过标准（如无运行时错误、生成特定日志文件）。
raw/items/8/issues/0/evidence: it must have a simulation module incorporated so we can try the complete system off-line on our development computer
raw/items/8/issues/0/rewrite: The UI‑Editor shall include an integrated simulation mode that can be executed on the development computer without connection to the Vector System hardware.
raw/items/1/issues/1/evidence: to guide users quickly and effectively.
raw/items/1/issues/1/rewrite: For a predefined set of representative user tasks covering at least 80% of typical usage, at least 80% of first‑time users shall be able to locate the corresponding service detail screen within 60 seconds and no more than 3 navigation actions in moderated usability testing (n ≥ 12).
raw/items/3/issues/1/rewrite: Using the UI Editor, a user shall be able, in a single design session, to: (1) create a new screen; (2) place at least three different widget types on the screen via drag‑and‑drop; (3) change each widget's label, position, and size via a property panel; and (4) save and reload the layout with all changes preserved.
raw/items/4/issues/1/evidence: able to handle context specific dialogs
raw/items/4/issues/1/rewrite: For any dialog sequence of ≤ 5 turns containing coreference (e.g., "book it" referring to a previously mentioned flight), the system shall return a fully resolved intent with all required slots filled and a correct response in at least 95% of cases in a predefined test set of at least 200 dialogs.
raw/items/5/issues/1/evidence: self explic able and understand users' needs
raw/items/5/issues/1/rewrite: At least 80% of first‑time test users must be able to complete the defined primary task flow without consulting external documentation or support, and at least 80% of surveyed users must rate the clarity of the system's functions and the relevance of its responses as ≥ 4 on a 5‑point Likert scale.
raw/items/7/issues/1/evidence: shall adapt to the situation and the pilot's state and task
raw/items/7/issues/1/rewrite: The adaptive interface shall, within 2 seconds after detection of a predefined condition (flight situation, pilot state indicator, or pilot task) from the adaptation rule set ARS‑R32, switch to the corresponding interface configuration defined in that rule set.
raw/items/0/issues/1/evidence: quickly and effectively and avoid cognitive overloads caused by information overflow
raw/items/0/issues/1/rewrite: For each defined critical user task, in a usability test with at least 10 representative first‑time users: (1) at least 90% of participants shall complete the task without external assistance within 60 seconds; (2) the mean NASA‑TLX overall workload score shall be below 30/100; and (3) no more than 5% of participants shall report feeling overwhelmed by the amount of information shown on any single screen.
raw/items/8/issues/1/evidence: try the complete system off-line on our development computer before loading the generated code into the Vector Syst em.
raw/items/8/issues/1/rewrite: When using the UI‑Editor on a development computer, the integrated simulation module shall allow the user, without connecting to the Vector System hardware, to: (1) load the generated UI code; (2) start a simulation run; (3) execute all configured UI navigation and interaction operations via the graphical interface; and (4) observe UI state changes consistent with the expected behavior on the target Vector System.
